title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Front Cover

Captive golden mantella (Mantella aurantiaca), an endangered Malagasy poison frog. In the wild, eggs are laid on land near forest pools, with summer season rains washing hatching tadpoles into nearby swampy waters. In this issue of Ethology Amin et al. show that these tadpoles have clear preferences to be reared in dark environments, which has implications for ex-situ conservation of this species. Photo by Jade Newton-Youens.
